method: Final six of 12 model trials: 2 debug Rust binaries x 3 TypeScript coding tasks, labelled repeat 2; reverse arm order from first set. Same Electron app, runtime, natural task prompts, Gemini 3.8 Flash, default desktop reasoning effort, legacy loop, native on, Jev and Axwise off. Actual UI Settings and Send, fresh profiles and workspaces, autonomous mode, developer/todo and native tools, no Code Mode. Identical Goose-child filesystem confinement validated per row; Electron, network and IPC not confined by this added boundary. Setup and independent oracle/typecheck/regression-mutation checks excluded from Send-to-terminal time. No per-row retries. 360-second limit, normal Rust action default 1000, local model-request capability capped at 60 calls. First six trials retained separately with the artificial 24-turn cap; do not pool completion/timing results across the two budgets. Normal OAuth token read and validated by the parent before each row; it never enters Goose or tool process environments. Confined auth command returns an expiring local-only capability limited to 60 POST chat-completion requests. The parent relay substitutes the real OAuth header only for that endpoint and production authentication remains enforced. No credential file or generic proxy. Seven earlier UI setup attempts failed Keychain access before any model request and are preserved separately. Source hashes frozen before live calls. No direct comparisons with the previous 48-task matrix.

limitations: Two repeats per workload; exploratory, no statistical or general reliability claim.
Tasks are capped at 24 turns and 360 seconds. A terminal ACP response can still mean action-budget exhaustion, recorded separately.
All TypeScript synthetic tasks, debug builds, native on and Jev/Axwise off; legacy loop only.
Baseline and candidate bundle selection guidance, tool-description/configuration changes and the explicit-unlock fix; this does not isolate one code change.
Times include failed outcomes; comparisons of successful subsets select survivors. Setup and independent checks excluded.
Local scoped authentication adapter preserves real parent authentication but does not test production Keychain compatibility.
Provider token usage is final reported usage per HTTP request, including associated UI requests. Cache/provider load are uncontrolled.
